meta.description: visitorStore empty and/or no valid token. Auth screen shown.
Valid token present; visitorStore still empty. Worker must select master spreadsheet.
File selected. Worker reviews the file name. No Drive calls made. FILE_CONFIRMED proceeds; FILE_REJECTED re-opens Picker.
visitorStore hydrated; no active search or selection.
Search returns 2–15 results. Worker must tap one to select.
Single visitor selected. Full visitor card shown. Action buttons driven by attendanceStatus.
Camera active. No candidate in frame. Frame overlay visible with instructional label.
Barcode candidate in frame. Hold-progress arc counting 800ms. Distinct color shift on frame.
Lock confirmed. Frame flashes green. Haptic pulse fires. Audio chirp plays. Result dispatched.
Lock failed or ambiguous read. Frame flashes amber. Retry label shown.
Camera permission refused. Zone replaced with icon + Spanish error message + retry button.
BarcodeDetector API unavailable. @zxing loaded. Small non-intrusive fallback badge shown.
End-of-event sync in progress. Full-screen overlay active. No attendance operations possible.
Worker tapped 'Cambiar archivo' with unsynced records. Bottom-sheet modal shown. All attendance interactions disabled.
visitorStore cleared; masterFileId, workingFileId, asistenciaColumn nulled in sessionStateStore; accessToken, refreshToken, tokenIssuedAt preserved. RESET_COMPLETE transitions to FILE_PICKER_PENDING.
Sync complete. Full-screen success view shows count of records pushed to Drive. Worker must tap 'Continuar' to acknowledge and transition to AUTH_PENDING.

guards.candidateStillLocked: Returns true when the barcode candidate value has not changed or been lost during the 800ms hold window
guards.hasPendingAttendance: Returns true when event.pendingCount > 0 (caller pre-fetches via countPendingAttendance() before dispatching RESET_INITIATED)
guards.noPendingAttendance: Returns true when event.pendingCount === 0 (caller pre-fetches via countPendingAttendance() before dispatching RESET_INITIATED)

actions.storeOrphanFileId: Holds orphan file ID in transient machine context for collision resolution
actions.storeWorkingFileIdFromOrphan: Writes orphan file ID as workingFileId to sessionStateStore['CURRENT_SESSION']
actions.storeWorkingFileId: Writes newly-copied file ID as workingFileId to sessionStateStore['CURRENT_SESSION']
actions.showCollisionCheckError: Renders inline error in FILE_PICKER_PENDING zone
actions.showDeleteError: Renders inline error in COLLISION_PROMPT overlay
actions.showCopyError: Renders inline error in FILE_PICKER_PENDING zone
actions.showFetchError: Renders inline error in FILE_PICKER_PENDING zone
actions.setSelectedVisitor: Writes selected visitor record to transient machine context
actions.setSelectedVisitorFromBarcode: Looks up record by visitorId from barcode payload; writes to transient context
actions.clearSearch: Clears search input value and result list in Zone 2
actions.writeAttendanceToIDB: Sets attendanceStatus=true, attendanceTimestamp=ISO-8601 now(), syncedWithCloud=false in visitorStore
actions.resetSearchAndSelection: Clears search input, result list, and selected visitor from transient context
actions.scheduleToast: Queues a non-blocking success toast (3000ms display)
actions.scheduleChirp: Queues the Web Audio API confirmation chirp (non-blocking)
actions.clearAttendanceRecord: Sets attendanceStatus=false, attendanceTimestamp=null, syncedWithCloud=false in visitorStore
actions.dispatchBarcodeResult: Fires BARCODE_RESULT event on appFlow with decoded visitorId payload
actions.flashGreen: Triggers Zone 1 frame green flash CSS animation class
actions.playChirp: Plays Web Audio API confirmation chirp (~880Hz, 150ms)
actions.triggerHaptic: Calls navigator.vibrate(50) if vibration API is supported
actions.flashAmber: Triggers Zone 1 frame amber flash CSS animation class
actions.updateStoredToken: Writes new accessToken and tokenIssuedAt to sessionStateStore; preserves refreshToken if absent from response
actions.showReauthError: Renders re-auth failure message in sync overlay with retry button
actions.showSyncError: Renders sync failure message in sync overlay with specific HTTP error label and retry button
actions.setRetriggerPicker: Sets context.retriggerPicker = true so AWAITING_SELECTION auto-opens the Picker on next entry
actions.openPickerIfRetrigger: If context.retriggerPicker === true, programmatically opens the Google Picker; always paired with clearRetriggerPicker on CONFIRMING_SELECTION entry
actions.clearRetriggerPicker: Resets context.retriggerPicker = false once the Picker has been re-opened or a fresh selection has been made
actions.storeSyncedCount: Writes event.syncedCount into context.syncedCount on PUSH_SUCCESS so the SYNC_SUCCESS screen can display the number of records pushed to Drive
